name: AddressHero
summary: Address validation for Shopify stores: checks delivery addresses at checkout and, on the Pro plan, corrects them automatically.
best_for: Shopify store owners who lose money on mistyped or incomplete delivery addresses and want checks at checkout, with automatic correction as a paid step up
skip_if: you sell outside Shopify, you want a fixed bill whatever your order volume, or you want a product we have tested ourselves instead of one read from its public pages
honest_knock: Lite does not validate against address databases or correct automatically. Pro bills every order it checks, including correct ones, and the docs say you cannot set a spending stop lower than the default. The pricing page does not make clear which plan has which correction features. Prices exclude taxes.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-13 on addresshero.com/pricing, US dollars) AddressHero sells three plans for Shopify stores, each with a 14-day free trial. Lite costs $9.99 a month flat and is described as minimal, for early-stage stores. Pro costs $0.04 per validated order and is for stores that optimise profit at scale. Enterprise has no listed price, is billed per address and is aimed at stores with 50,000 or more orders a month; the page offers a demo instead. The terms say prices are net of applicable taxes, all charges are billed in USD, and recurring and usage-based charges are billed every 30 days. Per the vendor's docs, read 15 October 2026, Lite does not validate against address databases and does not correct automatically, while Pro adds post-checkout validation, automatic correction, customer prompts on the Thank You and Order Status pages, order tagging, on-hold workflows, customer emails and a Klaviyo integration. The pricing page lists the correction features in a shared feature list without saying which plan has which, so we follow the docs. Pro bills every validated order, whether the address was right or wrong; orders without a shipping address are not validated or billed. The docs say a self-configurable spending stop below the default limit does not exist today. We did not install the app, so we do not know the real cost for a store of your size.

schema_offer.description: Lite, Lite $9.99 a month flat; Pro $0.04 per validated order, billed every 30 days with every validated order counted; Enterprise has no listed price; all plans show a 14-day free trial; prices are net of taxes. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-13.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested AddressHero on a Shopify development store: the install, the Format Validation switch in the onboarding, the Format Validation page with its in-app example, the tab In Checkout Validation that needs Shopify Plus, the plan choice with Minimal and Pro, the Shopify Approve subscription screen for Minimal with a test charge that was approved without a card, and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. No real checkout was seen blocking an address. Install: the App Store listing (English) says Free to install. Free trial available. and lists three plans: Pay per Address (14 days free, then US and CA $0.01, DACH $0.02, UK $0.04, other $0.03 per address), Pay per Order ($0.04 per order, 14 days free) and Minimal ($9.99 / month). The dossier only knows Lite at $9.99 and Pro at $0.04 per order, so the listing has one extra plan. The install form was sent at about 13:11; the first Install click opened a new tab outside our own tab group, and the second attempt showed the Install app dialog asking for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, which was approved. The app stood in Settings, Apps at once and opened without an account, password, demo or call. Core action, Format Validation: the onboarding step Detect address issues in checkout opened by itself; the switch Format Validation was turned on and the toast said Saved successfully. That took 3 clicks (Start onboarding, the switch, Next) and about 2 minutes after the install (about 13:13). The step Fix address issues after checkout (Add AddressHero to your thank you page) was skipped. The page Format Validation then shows Active with the points No orders without a house number, Blocks special characters carriers can't print and Customer fixes it before paying, the settings Missing House Number and Special Characters are on, and there is a tab Packing stations / PO Boxes. An example in the app shows the address 5th Ave with the error Please add your house number to continue. and a greyed out Pay now button. This is an example inside the app: no real checkout was seen blocking an address, because the store has a password and no test order was placed. Tabs on the free setup: the tab In Checkout Validation says In-Checkout Validation is only available on Shopify Plus, with a greyed out switch labelled Upgrade plan and an example card We found an address that might be more accurate; the tab General shows its options (for example House number in line 2, Skip ZIP+4 code correction (US only) and Hide Extension for Format Errors) with the label Upgrade plan. The dashboard shows Address Error Rate 0 %, Total Addresses Edited 0 and Saved Support Tickets 0, with a note to switch to Pro for email typos, suspicious names and advanced address issues. Plans: the in-app plan choice shows Minimal (Basic address validation for every order) at $9.99 / month with Start 14 day free trial, with Format checks on and Address validation and Automatic address correction crossed out, plus 24/7 Live Chat on and Done-for-you setup and Money-back guarantee crossed out, and AddressHero Pro (Advanced address checking billed per order) at $0.04 / order, also with Start 14 day free trial and every feature on. The app calls the cheap plan Minimal, the dossier calls it Lite. Pay per Address from the listing was not offered in the app. Checkout: Minimal was chosen as the cheapest plan. The Shopify screen Approve subscription said You will not be billed for this test charge. and You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., with a subtotal of $9,99 plus any applicable taxes, a total of $9,99 due 1 Dec and $9,99 USD every 30 days. The row Add payment method was on the screen but nothing had to be entered. The test charge was approved (Approve) without a card or payment method; nothing was billed. Cancelling: Settings, Apps, the menu of the row AddressHero (Open app, View details, Get support, Uninstall). The dialog Uninstall AddressHero ? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app will be deleted and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (Testing multiple apps). The plan cannot be cancelled apart from the app; uninstalling ends it. The app was uninstalled at about 13:19 and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: real address validation in a checkout or a test order, Shopify Plus In-Checkout Validation, post-checkout validation, automatic correction, the Pro plan, Pay per Address, emails and the enterprise demo. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; no theme change was saved and no app embed was switched on. Other apps were not touched. One extra tab opened by the first Install click could not be closed by us. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The plan is called Minimal in the app and Lite in the dossier, the listing has a third plan Pay per Address that the app did not offer and the dossier lacks, In-Checkout Validation and most General options show Upgrade plan on a Basic store, the Format Validation page shows only an in-app example and not a real checkout, and the first Install click opened a tab outside our tab group.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested AddressHero on a Shopify development store: the install, the Format Validation switch in the onboarding, the Format Validation page with its in-app example, the tab In Checkout Validation that needs Shopify Plus, the plan choice with Minimal and Pro, the Shopify Approve subscription screen for Minimal with a test charge that was approved without a card, and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. No real checkout was seen blocking an address. Install: the App Store listing (English) says Free to install. Free trial available. and lists three plans: Pay per Address (14 days free, then US and CA $0.01, DACH $0.02, UK $0.04, other $0.03 per address), Pay per Order ($0.04 per order, 14 days free) and Minimal ($9.99 / month). The dossier only knows Lite at $9.99 and Pro at $0.04 per order, so the listing has one extra plan. The install form was sent at about 13:11; the first Install click opened a new tab outside our own tab group, and the second attempt showed the Install app dialog asking for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, which was approved. The app stood in Settings, Apps at once and opened without an account, password, demo or call. Core action, Format Validation: the onboarding step Detect address issues in checkout opened by itself; the switch Format Validation was turned on and the toast said Saved successfully. That took 3 clicks (Start onboarding, the switch, Next) and about 2 minutes after the install (about 13:13). The step Fix address issues after checkout (Add AddressHero to your thank you page) was skipped. The page Format Validation then shows Active with the points No orders without a house number, Blocks special characters carriers can't print and Customer fixes it before paying, the settings Missing House Number and Special Characters are on, and there is a tab Packing stations / PO Boxes. An example in the app shows the address 5th Ave with the error Please add your house number to continue. and a greyed out Pay now button. This is an example inside the app: no real checkout was seen blocking an address, because the store has a password and no test order was placed. Tabs on the free setup: the tab In Checkout Validation says In-Checkout Validation is only available on Shopify Plus, with a greyed out switch labelled Upgrade plan and an example card We found an address that might be more accurate; the tab General shows its options (for example House number in line 2, Skip ZIP+4 code correction (US only) and Hide Extension for Format Errors) with the label Upgrade plan. The dashboard shows Address Error Rate 0 %, Total Addresses Edited 0 and Saved Support Tickets 0, with a note to switch to Pro for email typos, suspicious names and advanced address issues. Plans: the in-app plan choice shows Minimal (Basic address validation for every order) at $9.99 / month with Start 14 day free trial, with Format checks on and Address validation and Automatic address correction crossed out, plus 24/7 Live Chat on and Done-for-you setup and Money-back guarantee crossed out, and AddressHero Pro (Advanced address checking billed per order) at $0.04 / order, also with Start 14 day free trial and every feature on. The app calls the cheap plan Minimal, the dossier calls it Lite. Pay per Address from the listing was not offered in the app. Checkout: Minimal was chosen as the cheapest plan. The Shopify screen Approve subscription said You will not be billed for this test charge. and You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., with a subtotal of $9,99 plus any applicable taxes, a total of $9,99 due 1 Dec and $9,99 USD every 30 days. The row Add payment method was on the screen but nothing had to be entered. The test charge was approved (Approve) without a card or payment method; nothing was billed.
